label: KSafe
description: Karoo safety extension on two layers: REACTIVE (crash detection, SOS, check-in, HR-based medical episode and wellness detection) and PREVENTIVE (carb and hydration tracking that adapts to your effort using the Karoo's HR and power zones, reminding you to fuel before bonking or dehydration impairs your judgment on the bike). Sends emergency alerts via WhatsApp (CallMeBot), Telegram, Pushover or ntfy.
releaseNotes: New: personal sweat calibration. Weigh yourself before and after a ride and enter it on the new "Last ride" card in the Fueling tab, and KSafe learns how much you sweat. Dynamic hydration now aims at 80 % of your estimated sweat instead of 100 % (adjustable), and after long rides you see your estimated sodium loss with an optional bottle-concentration hint. Since 2.2.2: crash and heart-rate detection recover if a Karoo data stream stops mid-ride; fewer false crash alerts (GPS freezes, leaning the bike after a bump, standing the bike upright after a pothole); less battery (only the sensors your features need); option to turn off the ride-start warning (Provider tab). Fueling: no reminder right after you log a drink or food, and a timed reminder no longer arrives just before an "Eat now — behind" or "Drink now — behind" alert — you get one alert instead of two.
